protocol: Paper round on the B17 batch (slab-on-grade field R506.1 + 6-mil vapor retarder R506.2.3 + slab-field yd³/sqft takeoff) per review/BLUEPRINTS.md. Pure buildPlanSet in the /private/tmp/pilot-b17 worktree at the pin, compared against a detached worktree at the base 3ff4ec5 with a FIXED date so sheets byte-compare. Three sets each side: demo-house-FL (fc866f2f271b over HTTP, ground level, 5 slabs incl. the slab-less Living/Kitchen wing — 14 sheets), twostorey-NY-ground (composed 9×6 shell + interior bearing partition + slab with a 1.2×1.6 utility hole, node on the GROUND storey — 13 sheets), twostorey-NY-upper (same scene, node on STOREY 1 with framed floor, stair hole + 3.51 m slider RO — 11 sheets), plus a 41-flag pagination stress set. All 38 pin sheets rasterized with Playwright page.setContent @2x and the affected ones WALKED; foundation-sheet linework pixel-probed through the strips; member dumps + takeoff JSON diffed member-by-member. Evidence: /tmp/b17-exam/{out,out-base}/ + crops.
verdict: REVISE — the FOUNDATION plan is exactly what the round asked for (translucent layer-ZERO slab field, hardware legible on top, hole/band carves honest, quantities member-exact, warning verbatim, upper storeys byte-equal), but the SIDE VIEWS lie about the pour: on the demo section, slab strips whose axis lies parallel to the cut plane print as 0.66–1.2 m-tall dashed picket bands straddling grade — memberAxis uses the SECOND-largest dim (the strip's plan width) as stroke thickness, so the 3-1/2" slab draws up to ~13× too thick, overprinting stud bottoms and the perimeter detail, and the coincident vapor retarder doubles the band. Same class pollutes all four demo elevations and lays gray ribbons across the cover isometric. The two-storey section is the proof the intent is right: there the strips CROSS the plane and print as a thin dark 4.5 px cut band at grade — a perfect new stratum. One rendering fix (plate-role stroke width = thickness dim; suppress the membrane on side views) closes the round.

FOCUS-5-section-stratum.evidence: twostorey-NY-ground 11-section: CORRECT — strips cross the cut plane and print as dark #222 cut rects 4.5 px tall (= 0.0889 m at 1:75) tiled edge-to-edge between the stemwalls: the slab reads as a thin stratum at grade under the walls, membrane a 1.5 px line under it. demo-house-FL 11-section: WRONG — slab_1's strips lie PARALLEL to the cut plane and print via the 'in-band beyond' path as dashed lines with stroke-width = memberAxis w = the strip's PLAN WIDTH: measured 45.2/25.0/20.5/9.9 px (= 1.20/0.66/0.54/0.26 m) centered at y 522.1, i.e. a picket band straddling grade from ~+0.55 m into the stud bottoms to ~−0.65 m, at 0.6 opacity across the whole west band (SVG x 263–631); the vapor retarder draws an IDENTICAL second band 2.3 px lower (exhibits: /tmp/b17-exam/crop-section-grade-pin.png vs -base.png; the 10 added SVG lines). The 3-1/2" pour reads as a ~4-ft-deep mass — a lie about geometry on paper. Same class on all four demo elevations (heavy gray comb below grade, e.g. south: foundation strokes to 45.2 px vs base max 20.5) and the cover isometric (gray dashed ribbons across the interior framing, absent at base). Root cause: memberAxis returns w = second-largest dim — right for sticks, wrong for PLATE members whose width >> thickness. Bonus dead ink: plane-CROSSING strips also emit degenerate zero-length dashed lines (x1==x2, butt caps, invisible), each duplicated 2× (50 added elements on the ground section for 38 members).
FOCUS-5-section-stratum.note: The subfloor deck shares this class on upper-storey elevations (20.5 px floor-framing strokes — pre-existing, byte-identical at base, never flagged because it blends into the platform band). Fix once for all plate roles: side-view stroke width = the THICKNESS dim (min dim) for slab/vapor-retarder/subfloor, and suppress the vapor retarder on side views entirely (0.15 mm — legend-only, mirroring the plan-sheet stance); drop the degenerate zero-length emits.
